S55.29.needs: a connected connector (set up from Plus menu > Connectors); an outside account for that app
S55.29.note: The name comes from a server-side template in tool-loop.ts that shows as an activity step summary (rendered in bubbles.ts); the code does not show the answer text itself naming the provider. Without a display name the step reads "Using connector". The bubbles.ts:844 line is the search-sources step ("Sources for $QUERY$"), not a connector attribution. The exact step location in the side panel was not confirmed as a visible heading.
steps: Open the AGI side panel and sign in.
Click the plus (+) button and choose Connectors, which opens the connector directory on the web; connect an app there, then return to the side panel.
In the side panel, send a question that needs the connected app's data.
Wait for the answer, then open or look at the activity steps shown with it.
Look for a step that reads "Using <app name> connector" and confirm it names the app that supplied the data, as Expected says.
S55.29.where: Side panel > Plus menu (+) > Connectors to connect an app (it opens the connector directory on the web). Then ask a question that uses the connected app, and read the step row under the answer.
